name: mars-v2-monorepo
description: MARS v2 - Anatomy Learning Platform Monorepo

scripts.dev: npm run dev --workspace=server & npm run dev --workspace=client
scripts.build: npm run build --workspace=shared && npm run build --workspace=server && npm run build --workspace=client
scripts.lint: npm run lint --workspace=client && npm run lint --workspace=server
scripts.type-check: npm run type-check --workspace=shared && npm run type-check --workspace=client && npm run type-check --workspace=server
